data.content_ref: inline:The checklist-panel setup in 083573bb50cb reduces to a single-evaluation calibration design, because the panel-checklist rule-divergence stratum is the only signal that can isolate the checklist's causal contribution to accuracy; refuted if the checklist is shown to causally structure panel deliberation in a way that can be isolated even when rule-divergence is empty (e.g., by comparing structured-vs-unstructured panel conditions).
